concepts.title: Cinematic Discovery
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one exceptionally polished, high fidelity macOS desktop application UI design image for All Set's Wallpaper tab. A fresh original design, no reference images. Landscape approximately 16:10, rendered large and sharp; flat front-on app screenshot filling the composition, no laptop device, no perspective, no external callouts. Midnight navy-black canvas, restrained cyan and violet ambient light, subtle native glass ONLY on two compact floating navigation capsules, hairline borders, clean SF Pro style typography, exquisite spacing, realistically buildable SwiftUI components. Rounded macOS window with traffic-light dots and "All Set" top left. Top navigation centered: "Island", "Desktop" (selected), "Workspace", "Tools", "System". Below it a smaller navigation: "Themes", "Widgets", "Favorites", "Wallpaper" (selected), "Look & Layout", "Wallpaper Options", "On Your Desktop". Wallpaper page only; do not show desktop widget collages, theme cards, clocks or calendars. Preserve the real content-source labels "Aerial Videos", "Art", "My Videos". Include functional-looking search, favorites, wallpaper selection and preview. One simple clean toolbar, no nested capsule outlines or stacks of redundant filter bars. Rich original photographic landscapes and tasteful generative abstract wallpapers; no celebrities, brands, logos, watermarks or copyrighted characters. UI text must be crisp, coherent and sparing. No extra invented AI generation, subscriptions or community functionality. Layout direction: CINEMATIC DISCOVERY. Immersive full-width landscape hero taking approximately 43% of the window below navigation, a breathtaking turquoise aurora over a Nordic fjord, snowy mountains and glossy water. A single compact toolbar across the top of the hero with source tabs "Aerial Videos" selected, "Art", "My Videos", a search field right and a small "4K" selector. At the bottom left of hero, small eyebrow "FEATURED WALLPAPER", title "Northern Drift", metadata "Live · 4K · 24 MB". Under the title white "Set Wallpaper" button, understated "Preview" button and heart. A tiny top-right "On your desktop" status pill. The hero fades smoothly into the midnight page background below. Immediately below: section "Discover wallpapers", short subtitle "A new view, every day.", right aligned arrow buttons and "See all"; one horizontal row of five or six consistent rounded wide landscape thumbnail cards with imaginative scenery, small title/metadata overlays and hearts: "Coastal Light", "Forest Haze", "Violet Orbit", "Amber Dunes", "Alpine Still". At the bottom a section "Explore by mood" with three shorter wide collection panels labeled "Nature", "Space", "Abstract". Give hero prominence yet leave the first thumbnail row fully visible. Premium editorial cinematic experience, calm readable controls, disciplined alignment. Render ONLY this one complete design, not a comparison sheet.

Below, a translucent midnight horizontal filmstrip tray stretching nearly the full window width: five generously sized 16:10 thumbnail previews of this alpine twilight scene (selected with white/cyan rim), ocean coast, aurora, pale desert and a nebula. Neatly label beneath each thumbnail "Alpine Afterglow", "Coastal Light", "Northern Drift", "Amber Dunes", "Quiet Orbit". Small previous/next arrows at the tray ends, bottom text "1 of 24" subtle, and an unobtrusive "Browse all" pill at bottom right. Clear hierarchy: huge beautiful wallpaper, tasteful small typography, grounded filmstrip, highly readable white controls, restrained glass with no giant glowing border. Render ONLY this one complete design.
